# The AI Video Studio for DeepSeek Harness
**Plan AI short films the way multi-model teams actually work — storyboard, prompts, and shot pipeli
ne, one sidebar panel away from your agent sessions.**
README · Workflow (中文) · Screenshots · Changelog (中文)
`release` **v1.0.0** · `license` **MIT** · `topic` **dsh-plugin** · `install` **1 command**
English · 简体中文
**dsh-video** is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives your AI video production workflow a home insid
e the Harness Web UI. It adds a **Video Studio** panel to the left sidebar where you plan a short fi
lm the way multi-model teams actually work: a director (your coding agent) writes the story and prom
pts, a painter model (e.g. Codex) draws concept art and first/last frames, and an animator model (e.
g. Seedance) turns frames into seconds of paid video.

> The workflow this plugin manages was popularized by the article
> *"Claude Code/Codex + Seedance A

I video: from an idea to a finished film"* —
> one director agent, cheap text iterations first, expe
nsive video generations last.
| 中文 | English |
## Why
AI video is expensive: regenerating a shot costs money by the second, while rewriting a prompt is fr
ee. The discipline that keeps costs down — *find errors in text before they reach an image, and in i
mages before they reach video* — needs a place to live. dsh-video is that place: a storyboard sheet,
a prompt library, and a shot pipeline, one panel away from your agent sessions.
## Features
- **Sidebar entry** — the Video Studio registers as a global panel in the Harness left sidebar (next
to Plugins and Scheduled tasks), with three tabs: **Studio**, **Prompt library**, and **Failure mod

es**.
- **Director brief** — the full multi-model kickoff prompt: roles (you / director / painter /
animator), the Codex CLI invocation, the Seedance API endpoint, model ids with 720p prices (`doubao-
seedance-2-5-260628` ≈ ¥1.5/s, `doubao-seedance-2-0-mini-260615` ≈ ¥0.5/s), and the seven working ru

les (audit agents, new files per version, never top up credits).
- **Pre-flight check** — painter to
ol / ffmpeg / Python / `ARK_API_KEY` toggles per project, with a copyable report; nothing gets gener

ated before the environment is ready.
- **Story & style card** — one-line message, hook, story struc
ture (episodic vs continuous), art style, character sheet, palette table, music. The rules from the

article are printed right under each field.
- **Storyboard shots** — per shot: what happens, main ac
tion, what is moving, link to next shot, shot size/camera/move, composition (38%/62% rule), estimate

d seconds, per-second beats, frame notes for the painter, sound.
- **Seven-section prompt builder**
— one click assembles the article's `[画风][镜头][构图与配色][人物][逐秒][声音][约束]` prompt from the fields above,

in both languages.
- **Frame checklist** — the article's 8 first/last-frame checks (props exist, bys
tanders staged, no shared poses, headroom, wind consistency, phone-size readability, stray objects,

overlay drift) as per-shot checkboxes.
- **Cost ledger** — every submitted generation (model, second
s, kept/failed, file/failure reason), auto-priced from the model id, with project totals against the

budget cap.
- **Review decision** — cut vs code-fix vs regenerate, with the article's ordering rule

printed in the field.

## Requirements

- A running DeepSeek Harness installation (Desktop app or `dsh web`).
- No build step, no runtime de
pendencies — the plugin is a plain-JavaScript Cordis bundle.
## Install
Install into any non-desktop Harness profile with the `dsh` CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Inside the **Desktop** profile, install the bundle through the Harness plugin manager (Plugins → Add
→ local directory), then restart the app so the new client module generation is loaded.
Alternatively, publish or fork this repository and install by Git URL wherever `dsh plugin add` acce
ively, publish or fork this repository and install by Git URL wherever `dsh plugin add` accepts one.
## Usage

1. Click the **dsh-video** icon in the left sidebar's global panel list.
2. **New project** — name i

t and set the aspect ratio / target length.
3. **Add shot** — describe the scene, the camera move, a
nd write two prompts: the frame prompt for your painter model and the video prompt for your animator

model.
4. Work the pipeline top-down: fix the text first, generate frames, check them, only then ge

nerate video, and advance the status badge as each shot completes.
5. **Copy director brief** into a
new Harness session to bootstrap the full multi-model workflow with your agent.
## Project structure
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**How it plugs in.** The bundle patch inserts one Loader entry named after the package. On the Clien
t, the module registers two slot factories: an icon into `sidebar.panellist` (the left sidebar's glo
bal panel list) and the full panel into the keyed `main` slot under the same id, so selecting the si
debar entry swaps the central pane to the Studio. All styling uses `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens only
ebar entry swaps the central pane to the Studio. All styling uses `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens only.
## Compatibility

| Harness | 0.2.x (client slot API: `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, `__ModuleLoader__`) |
| Plugin API

| Cordis bundle + plain-JS client module |
| Locales | `en`, `zh` |
## Contributing
Issues and PRs are welcome. Keep client code plain JavaScript (no build step), route every visible s
tring through the i18n dictionary in `client.js`, and style only with Harness theme tokens.
